research_workflows.name: Google Research - AI co-scientist (2025)
research_workflows.description: Multi-agent hypothesis-generation architecture: Generation, Reflection, Ranking (Elo-based tournament over hypotheses), Evolution, Proximity, and Meta-review roles under a supervisor, run as a generate-debate-evolve loop. Also the stated source of the open-access/negative-results literature bias behind A13. Validation claims are single-vendor self-reported and are deliberately not imported.

research_workflows.name: Antonio Gulli, Agentic Design Patterns (Springer, 2025) - Ch. 21 Exploration and Discovery
research_workflows.description: Book chapter describing the AI co-scientist role taxonomy and its stated limitations (bounded by open-access literature; no access to unpublished negative results). Basis for the hypothesis-generation section in SKILL.md and anti-pattern A13.

vendor_docs.name: OpenAI API Deprecations Page
vendor_docs.description: Authoritative lifecycle source. Checked 2026-09-07: the dated o3-deep-research and o4-mini-deep-research 2025-06-26 snapshots shut down 2026-07-23, and the current table names gpt-5.6-sol as substitute. Check this page plus the model catalog and account availability before wiring a model ID.

vendor_docs.name: xAI Developer Docs — Tools Overview
vendor_docs.description: Primary doc confirming xAI now documents server-side web_search and x_search tools (API-invocable, demonstrated with grok-4.5), priced by token usage plus tool invocations. No dedicated one-call deep-research report model yet. Verified 2026-07-11.

vendor_docs.name: Perplexity API Pricing
vendor_docs.description: Perplexity sonar-deep-research multi-component token pricing confirmed: $2/M input, $8/M output, $3/M reasoning, $2/M citation, $5 per 1,000 search queries. Whether a separate flat per-request fee applies is inconsistently reported by secondary sources as of 2026-07-11 — confirm on this page for your account tier before budgeting. Typical full-query cost now runs roughly $0.30–$1.30+ depending on reasoning depth and search count (higher than earlier estimates). Verified 2026-07-11.

vendor_docs.name: Anthropic Web Search Tool Docs (agents-and-tools path)
vendor_docs.description: Current canonical URL for Anthropic web search tool. GA, no beta header required. Three versions live: web_search_20250305 (basic), web_search_20260209 (dynamic filtering), web_search_20260318 (current — adds response-inclusion control). Dynamic filtering supported models: Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Mythos 5, Mythos Preview, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, Sonnet 4.6. Verified 2026-07-11.

vendor_docs.name: Anthropic Memory Tool Docs
vendor_docs.description: Primary doc for the Anthropic memory tool (memory_20250818): a client-side tool writing to a client-controlled persistent directory (conventionally /memories; path is application-defined, NOT a platform-mandated /mnt/memory/ mount). Confirmed GA, no beta header, available on all Claude 4+ models. Cross-session persistence is app-implemented. 'Dreaming'/'Auto Dream' is a Claude Code/community pattern, NOT a documented platform capability. Verified 2026-07-11.

vendor_docs.name: Anthropic News — Claude Sonnet 5
vendor_docs.description: Primary doc: Claude Sonnet 5 GA 2026-06-30, replaces Sonnet 4.6 as default free/Pro model, near-Opus agentic performance at lower cost. Verified 2026-07-11.

vendor_docs.name: Anthropic News — Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
vendor_docs.description: Primary doc: Mythos-class tier sits above Opus-class. Fable 5 and Mythos 5 GA 2026-06-09; briefly export-restricted to US persons 2026-06-12 through 2026-06-30; globally available again from 2026-07-01. Relevant to which Claude model to select for research-quality baselines. Verified 2026-07-11.
